title: Asian Games: Progella, Pagara lead Alas beach volleyball wins

blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas men’s and women’s beach volleyball squads kicked off their respective Asian Games campaigns on a high note on Monday at Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court. Alas breakout stars Khy Progella and Sofiah Pagara were good as advertised, dominating Maldives’ Fathimath Anal and Aminath Areesha, 21-6, 21-11, in Pool G of the women’s division. In the men’s division, Ronniel Rosales and James Buytrago took down Mongolia’s Amar Batmunkh and Shijir-Erdene Bat-Enkh, 21-11, 21-15.
